title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
reason: SEC investigation into Nvidia following CEO scandal is a major regulatory and market-moving event.

sources.summary: The SEC is opening a probe into Nvidia following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, reports The Wall Street Journal.
